name: Bokura no Ren'ai Shinrigaku Fan's Disc
original_name: ぼくらの恋愛心理学 fan's disc
source:
Among other goodies there are 20 short scenarios with mini-games centering on each character.
There are story pieces not included in the main game. These are past story, coupling story and afterstory.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-june-2003-sayonara.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
除此之外，还有20个简短的场景以及以每个角色为中心的迷你游戏。
有些故事片段未包含在主游戏中。这些是过去的故事、耦合的故事和后续的故事。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-june-2003-sayonara.html]vndbreview[/url]]
